summary: VisionWave Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding its wholly owned subsidiary's agreement to acquire 60% of VIP Lux Travel Ltd. and PKLST Tourism and Leisure Ltd. for up to ~15M NIS (~$3M) payable in 513,752 common shares valued at $6.02/share. The board has not yet stated a recommendation; no advisors named. Closing conditions include due diligence, regulatory approvals, and Israeli tax rulings. The stock-based consideration may dilute existing shareholders. Watch for regulatory clearance and completion of ancillary documents; the risk-arb spread hinges on stock volatility and closing certainty.
